early_close_condition: This market will close and expire early if a new leader is announced.
rules_primary: If Chen Jining is announced as the first new non-interim leader of the Chinese Communist Party (CCP) before Jan 1, 2045, then the market resolves to Yes.
rules_secondary: The market resolves when the first new non-interim leader is officially announced by the party or credible sources. The person need not have taken office before the deadline date, only be announced as the incoming leader. Interim or acting leaders do not qualify unless they are subsequently announced as the permanent leader. If multiple persons are simultaneously announced as co-leaders, the market resolves proportionally. Leadership contests that extend beyond the deadline date without an announcement resolve to No. The announcement must come from official party channels or be confirmed by multiple credible news sources.
title: Will Chen Jining become the next leader of the Chinese Communist Party (CCP) before Jan 1, 2045?

rules_primary: If the United States real GDP growth in 2029 is between 4.6% to 5.0%, then the market resolves to Yes.
rules_secondary:
This market is based on the Bureau of Economic Analysis’s advance estimate of real gross domestic product (GDP) growth in the United States for calendar year 2029. The Expiration Value will be the first-published annual percent change in real GDP for 2029 from BEA’s GDP release, expected with the advance estimate of Q4 2029 GDP in early 2030. Revisions published after expiration will not be considered.

All stated bounds are inclusive. For example, “5.6% to 6.0%” includes both 5.6% and 6.0%, “6.1% or above” includes 6.1%, and “0.0% or below” includes 0.0%.

rules_secondary: The case must meet the following requirements: (1) The petition for certiorari explicitly raises a claim or question under the Third Amendment to the United States Constitution as a question presented; OR (2) The lower court decision being appealed explicitly addressed a Third Amendment claim on the merits; OR (3) The Supreme Court's order granting certiorari explicitly identifies a Third Amendment issue as a question for review. For the avoidance of doubt:  A case where the Third Amendment is mentioned only in passing, in dicta, or as part of a general constitutional analysis without being a distinct claim SHALL NOT satisfy the Payout Criterion A case where the Third Amendment is raised only in amicus briefs but not by the parties SHALL NOT satisfy the Payout Criterion. Examples that WOULD resolve to Yes: the Court grants cert in a case where a homeowner challenges military housing requirements under the Third Amendment; the Court grants cert in a case where the question presented is "Whether police officers qualify as 'soldiers' under the Third Amendment”; the Court grants cert where a lower court ruled on the scope of Third Amendment protections and that ruling is being appealed.

early_close_condition: This market will close and expire early if the event occurs.
rules_primary: If the United States explicitly and formally recognizes Somaliland as a sovereign state independent from any previously recognized country after Issuance and before Jan 1, 2027, the market resolves to Yes.
rules_secondary:
This could include: opening a U.S. embassy with Somaliland, accepting an ambassador from Somaliland, including the entity as an independent country in U.S. Department of State country lists, or signing a formal treaty, bilateral agreement, or communique that explicitly identifies Somaliland as an independent and sovereign state.

Merely acknowledging a governing authority exists, without recognizing its authority, is insufficient to resolve the market to Yes. Establishing a consulate or liaison office without the formal status and language of recognition does not qualify. Trade offices, cultural centers, or other non-embassy missions are insufficient. Participation alongside the entity in international conferences, humanitarian aid missions, or multilateral forums does not in itself constitute recognition as a sovereign state. Nor does U.S. abstention or vote in an international organization automatically equate to bilateral recognition.
title: Will Trump recognize Somaliland?

early_close_condition: This market will close and expire early if the event occurs.
rules_primary: If US judicial independence is undermined before Jan 20, 2029, then the market resolves to Yes.
rules_secondary:
This is defined as any of the following occurring:
An executive order alters the structure of the judiciary. Such an order is considered to alter the judiciary’s structure if it does any of: a) modifies the number, organization, or composition of Article III courts (for example, changing the number of circuits or reassigning judges to different courts) b) changes the scope or limits the jurisdiction of federal courts in a manner that reduces their constitutionally guaranteed authority or c) alters the established procedures for the nomination, confirmation, or lifetime tenure of Article III judges (for example, by replacing lifetime tenure with term limits or otherwise diminishing the constitutional protections afforded to federal judges).
A bill becomes law that undermines judicial independence. Such a bill is considered to do so if it does any of: a) alters the jurisdiction or powers of the federal judiciary in a manner that is inconsistent with the established constitutional framework b) changes the lifetime appointment provisions for Article III judges—such as by replacing lifetime tenure with fixed terms or altering the removal process—thereby diminishing their constitutional protections or c) explicitly removes or materially reduces any protections guaranteed to federal judges under Article III of the Constitution.
Any federal judges are removed outside of the impeachment process – e.g. a federal judge is fired by the Executive, ordered to resign, or any other means than the constitutionally prescribed impeachment process.

Even if any of the above actions are immediately blocked by courts, the market will resolve to Yes.
subtitle: Before 2029
title: Will the independence of the judiciary be weakened during Trump's term?

rules_secondary:

If no government forms by Dec 31, 2028, the Contract resolves to "No one" if that is an option and No for all other strikes. If new elections are called before government formation, the Contract resolves to "No one" immediately and No for all other strikes.

These maps must be:
Formally adopted and enacted into law by the appropriate legislative or redistricting authority; AND
Not enjoined, vacated, stayed, or struck down in full by any court with jurisdiction over congressional redistricting in Maryland as of the Expiration Date; AND
In effect for use in the first scheduled federal election after its adoption

Maps that are temporarily stayed pending appeal but later upheld will resolve to YES if they are ultimately in effect by the Expiration Date

early_close_condition: This market will close and expire early if the event occurs.
rules_primary: If Georgia is the first Democratic primary or caucus during the 2028 presidential cycle, then the market resolves to Yes.
rules_secondary:
The determination is based on the official calendar or schedule announced or recognized by the party, not on when primaries or caucuses actually take place. Only primaries and caucuses that are officially recognized by the party as part of the presidential nominating process are considered. Unofficial “beauty contest” primaries, straw polls, or events where the party has indicated no delegates will be awarded are not encompassed by the Payout Criterion.

If multiple states are scheduled for the same date as the earliest date, then the markets for all such states will resolve so "Yes" holders receive $1 divided by the number of states scheduled for that earliest date rounded down to the nearest cent and "No" holders receive $1 minus the Yes payout. If the party has not announced an official calendar before the end date, then determination will be based on the consensus of Source Agencies regarding which state the party recognizes as scheduled first. Examples that would resolve the market to Yes include: the party announces that New Hampshire will hold the first primary on January 23, 2028 (where 2028 is the election year), the party releases an official calendar showing Iowa with the first caucus date, or the party announces Iowa and New Hampshire are both scheduled for the same date, which is the earliest date (both states’ markets resolve to $0.50). Examples that would NOT resolve the market to Yes include: a state announces it will go first but the party has not recognized this in their official calendar, a state holds an unsanctioned primary that the party says will result in no delegates, or a state is scheduled second or later in the party’s official calendar.
title: What state will be first in the Democratic presidential primary?

early_close_condition: This market will close and expire early if the endorsement occurs.
rules_primary: If Donald Trump publicly endorses Ron DeSantis in the 2028 presidential election before Mar 1, 2028, then the market resolves to Yes.
rules_secondary:
An "endorsement" requires:
A clear, affirmative statement of support for candidate's election
The statement must be public (not private communications)
The endorsement must specifically reference the 2028 presidential election or be clearly in context of the 2028 presidential election
The endorsement must come directly from Donald Trump or through official channels

The following scenarios would resolve to YES:
Donald Trump states "I endorse candidate for [office]"
Donald Trump states "I support candidate" with clear reference to the 2028 presidential election
Donald Trump states "I'm voting for candidate" publicly
Donald Trump states "candidate has my full support" for the 2028 presidential election
Donald Trump appears at campaign events specifically to endorse
Donald Trump releases official endorsement through their organization
Donald Trump allows their name/image to be used in candidate's campaign materials

Statements of obvious sarcasm (or which are immediately followed by clarifications that Donald Trump is joking) are NOT encompassed by the Payout Criterion.

The Contract shall resolve immediately upon confirmation of the first qualifying endorsement in the specified race. If multiple candidates are listed for a listed race and exactly one is endorsed, that candidate's strike resolves "Yes" at $1.00 and all other named-candidate strikes resolve "No." If multiple are endorsed, each endorsed candidate's strike resolves "Yes" at a value of ($1.00 / N) rounded down to the nearest $0.01. 

If no endorsement occurs before expiration, the "No one" strike resolves "Yes" at $1.00 and all named-candidate strikes resolve "No."
title: Will Donald Trump endorse Ron DeSantis in the 2028 presidential election before Mar 1, 2028?

The market resolves to the first person who, as a result of government formation following the election, is formally appointed, sworn in, or invested as Prime Minister according to the country's constitutional procedures, commands the confidence of the parliament/legislature, and exercises the full powers of the office (not serving in a caretaker/acting capacity from the previous government).

The market will expire at the sooner of the occurrence of the event or the first 10:00 AM ET after the release of the Advance Estimate of 2027 Q4 GDP.

early_close_condition: This market will close and expire following the first vote to confirm Kari Lake or their nomination being withdrawn.
rules_primary: If John Fetterman votes Yea for Kari Lake for United States Ambassador to Jamaica before Jan 1, 2028, then the market resolves to Yes.
rules_secondary:
Should such a vote result in the rejection of the Nominee via a procedure that does not result in the recording of a tally of votes, or should a withdrawal of the nominee's nomination be formally communicated to the United States Senate, this market shall resolve to No. Should a vote result in the confirmation of the Nominee via a procedure that does not result in the recording of a tally of votes, this market shall resolve to Yes. Should more than one Senate confirmation vote on the confirmation of the Nominee to the Office be held, the outcome of the first such vote will be used to resolve this market. If the nominee is withdrawn (or intent to nominate a nominee is withdrawn by the President or President-elect), then the market will resolve to No. 

The outcomes of committee votes, hearings, or reports, cloture votes and other procedural votes will have no impact on the resolution of this market. Once the vote has been closed and the correct result of the vote has been announced, a request by John Fetterman to add, remove, or alter a vote shall not be considered for purposes of resolving this market, regardless of any change to the official vote tally reported by the website senate.gov or any other official source.
title: Will John Fetterman vote for Kari Lake?

rules_secondary:
Donald Trump achieves the superior outcome through the following exclusive hierarchy:

Net Monetary Recovery (Highest Priority): Donald Trump achieves the superior outcome if they receive a larger net monetary award than all opposing parties combined (after offsetting any awards against Donald Trump). Attorney's fees and costs are excluded.

Substantive Legal Victory (Second Priority): If no net monetary advantage exists, Donald Trump achieves the superior outcome if they prevail on claims seeking the largest dollar amount of relief in their original pleadings, or if relief amounts are equal, on the greater number of primary causes of action.

Case Termination Advantage (Third Priority): If the case terminates without substantive judgment, Donald Trump achieves the superior outcome if (as defendant) all claims are dismissed with prejudice, or (as plaintiff) opposing parties voluntarily dismiss all claims with prejudice. All other termination scenarios result in no superior outcome for any party.

Settlements: Superior outcome if net payment flows to Donald Trump; no superior outcome if payment flows from Donald Trump; no party achieves superior outcome if terms are sealed or undisclosed.

Key exclusions: Applies only to trial-level resolution — specifically excludes all appeals processes. Procedural victories alone do not constitute superior outcomes.
title: Will Donald Trump win Donald J. Trump v. British Broadcasting Corporation?

custom_strike.Combo: Trump's VoteHub approval rating rise above 48% in 2026 + Republicans retain control of both the House of Representatives and Senate after the midterms + U.S. GDP growth is above 5% in any quarter from Q4 2025 to Q4 2026 (inclusive) + The U.S. unemployment rate (U-3) stays below 5% in 2026

early_close_condition: This market will close and expire early if any component becomes impossible to occur (resolving to No) or all components have been satisfied (resolving to Yes).
rules_primary:
If **ALL** of the following occur:

1. Trump's VoteHub approval rating rises above 48% in 2026 AND
2. Republicans retain control of both the House of Representatives and Senate after the midterms AND
3. U.S. GDP growth is above 5% in any quarter between Q4 2025 and Q4 2026 (inclusive) AND
4. The U.S. unemployment rate (U-3) stays below 5% in 2026

then the market resolves to Yes.
rules_secondary:
This is a combination market requiring ALL specified outcomes to occur for the contract to pay out. If ANY single component resolves to No or becomes impossible, the entire contract immediately resolves to No.

Each component is resolved according to its corresponding Kalshi ruleset:

- "Will Trump's VoteHub approval rating rise above 48% in 2026?" uses POLLINGAPPROVALINPERIOD
- "Will Republicans retain control of the House of Representatives and Senate after the midterms?" uses CONTROL
- "Will U.S. GDP grow by more than 5% in any quarter from Q4 2025 to Q4 2026 (inclusive)?" uses LGDP
- "Will the U.S. unemployment rate (U-3) stay below 5% in 2026?" uses ECONSTAT

For economic data releases, resolution uses the first officially released value (not preliminary or revised estimates unless specified). All conditions must be satisfied within the specified time period.

Additional specifications: POLLINGAPPROVALINPERIOD - the threshold need only be met once during the period; CONTROL - based on the Speaker of the House and President Pro Tempore of the Senate on Feb 1, 2027; LGDP - based on real GDP, quarter-over-quarter percent change, seasonally adjusted at annual rates (SAAR)

rules_primary: If the margin of victory for Hannah Pingree in the final round of the Maine Democratic gubernatorial primary falls within 3% to 6%, inclusive of its lower bound and exclusive of its upper bound, then the market resolves to Yes.
rules_secondary:
The margin of victory shall be calculated as follows based on the margin type.

For percentage points: the vote percentage received by Hannah Pingree minus the vote percentage received by the candidate/party/option that finishes immediately behind Hannah Pingree if Hannah Pingree wins, or the candidate/party that finishes first if Hannah Pingree loses.
For raw votes: the total votes received by Hannah Pingree minus the total votes received by the candidate/party/option that finishes immediately behind Hannah Pingree if Hannah Pingree wins, or the candidate/party/option that finishes first if Hannah Pingree loses.
For electoral votes: the electoral votes received by Hannah Pingree minus the electoral votes received by the candidate/party/option with the second-most electoral votes if Hannah Pingree wins, or the electoral votes received by Hannah Pingree minus the electoral votes received by the candidate/party/option with the most electoral votes if Hannah Pingree does not.

Each margin range is inclusive of its lower bound and exclusive of its upper bound. No rounding shall be applied to the calculated margin. For example, for consecutive ranges of 5-6% and 6-7%, a margin of 5.99999% resolves within the 5-6% range, while a margin of exactly 6% resolves within the 6-7% range. If Hannah Pingree runs under multiple parties or is listed multiple times, votes attributable to the same underlying natural Hannah Pingree will be summed.

If Hannah Pingree wins the election, the margin will be positive. If Hannah Pingree loses the election, the margin will be negative. If Hannah Pingree ties for first place, the margin shall be 0. For uncontested races where Hannah Pingree is the only candidate, the margin shall be 100 percentage points or the total number of votes cast (for raw votes).
title: Will the margin of victory for Hannah Pingree in the final round of the Maine Democratic gubernatorial primary be between 3% and 6%?
